title: Computer Architecture
description: A quantitative study of how digital logic, instruction sets, memory hierarchies, pipelines, and parallel hardware execute programs.
overview: The machine is developed from representation and state through instruction execution, memory and I/O, and parallel performance. Learners calculate the consequences of each abstraction and use traces or experiments to expose where a simplified model fails. The 187-hour sequence ends in a defended processor-backed design with correctness, performance, and fault evidence.

required: C or another systems language: pointers, arrays, compilation, and debugging
Binary arithmetic, Boolean algebra, and elementary probability
